purpose: Photographic concept mockups for the four active logo application screens.

prompts.a:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create one high-end photorealistic editorial photograph of physical brand collateral for MixedRoutes. Landscape 3:2 composition, close enough that material textures and printed logo are legible. This is a speculative brand application photograph for a design presentation, not a website screenshot, illustration, collage, labeled moodboard or layout.
Input image 1 is an EXACT LOGO REFERENCE ONLY: reproduce the central symbol's outline, internal negative spaces and proportions faithfully. Ignore the reference card's background, letter label and caption; never print those labels. Use the provided specific logo, not a generic M or a newly drawn letter. The logo must look printed or embroidered into the actual material with natural texture, lighting, and perspective.
MixedRoutes V2 palette: blue #1749E5, near-black #101114, white, lilac #C0AFFF, mint #A1E7CE, apricot #FFAC79. Typography is Geist-like clean modern sans serif, compact confident lowercase headlines. No gradients or gloss on printed artwork. No watermark or explanatory labels outside the objects. Restrained editorial lighting, realistic tactile materials, considered art direction. Exact optional brand name: "MixedRoutes". Never print any other brand names.
Scene: a warm stone studio table in soft daylight. Main object is a natural off-white heavyweight cotton tote lying flat at a three-quarter angle with its handles visible. Screen print the reference winding-paths logo in blue large and clearly recognizable on the tote, with small "MixedRoutes" below it. A restrained lilac winding route runs across the lower portion of the tote, ending in a round dot. Alongside the tote, lay a real textured A5 walking-club card and a blue woven lanyard with a cream event pass. Card shows the same small blue logo and the headline "take the long way." in bold black lowercase. Event pass shows the same white logo on blue, and only the small brand name. Objects are artfully arranged with slight overlap but every main logo remains fully visible. Fabric weave, stitching, paper fibers, metal clip and soft contact shadows clearly present. Three objects total, no people, no extra props.

Scene: quiet café product photography on a pale oak table with a softly blurred cream wall, no people. Three real objects: a chunky matte lilac ceramic mug with handle, a white takeaway coffee cup with an apricot paper sleeve and white lid, and a heavy textured cream postcard leaning against the mug. Print the EXACT single soft connected rounded M silhouette from reference very large in blue on the mug and in near-black on the apricot sleeve. On the postcard, use the EXACT M silhouette as a photographic window showing hikers among mountains, with the small blue symbol plus "MixedRoutes" below. Mug and cup should be hero objects with entire silhouettes legible, not wrapped out of view. Small exact postcard headline "a little more outside." in bold lowercase modern sans. Grounded, tactile, premium but attainable, morning side light, tiny real ceramic imperfections, natural shadows. No other objects.

A white premium cotton T-shirt is carefully laid out with natural folds, neck and both sleeves visible, taking about two thirds of the scene. Center-chest screenprint is the EXACT THREE-PIECE logo from reference, medium-large: circle apricot, diagonal lilac, upright pill blue, preserving exactly their shapes and relative positions. Small black wordmark "MixedRoutes" beneath the logo. Beside the shirt is one lilac A5 printed card with the exact full logo in black and the small headline "a little of everything." Below the card, a modest set of three die-cut vinyl stickers: one assembled multicolor exact logo, one circle in apricot, one diagonal component in lilac. These are physical cut stickers with thin white edges and natural shadows, arranged neatly without covering the T-shirt. Strong material realism, cotton weave and fine screenprint edge visible, soft sunny shadows, no hangers or people, restrained composition. Do not turn the logo into unrelated geometric decorations.
